setup: "Get PDF or Images": after import, register the googlesuper webhook (`cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper`, then `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_FILE_CREATED_TRIGGER`) and set webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId on the trigger node.
Setup value driveFolderId: Drive Folder id (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

hints: "Get PDF or Images" is a provider webhook (googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_FILE_CREATED_TRIGGER). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_FILE_CREATED_TRIGGER --account <connectedAccountId>`.
"Extract data from PDF" (extractFromFile.pdf): Parsed via googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_PARSE_FILE; the file must live on Google Drive (upload first if the previous step only has bytes/base64).

"Extract data from PDF": GOOGLESUPER_PARSE_FILE needs a Drive file_id (and googlesuper credential). If the upstream step only has file bytes, upload with GOOGLESUPER_CREATE_FILE_FROM_TEXT / Drive upload first, then parse.
"Send data to A.I." authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).

"Send data to A.I." called the OpenRouter API (meta-llama/llama-3.1-70b-instruct:free) over HTTP; it now runs on LLMChain with a Chat Model and provider connector credential, and later steps read the answer text instead of the provider's JSON.
"Convert to CSV2" (convertToFile.csv): The file is a `{ data, fileName, mimeType }` object (text, or base64 for toBinary); point the next step at `data`.
"Convert to CSV" (convertToFile.csv): The file is a `{ data, fileName, mimeType }` object (text, or base64 for toBinary); point the next step at `data`.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## How to extract PDF and image text into CSV using n8n (without manual data entry)

This workflow will extract text data from PDF and images, then store it as CSV.

[💡 You can read more about this workflow here](https://rumjahn.com/how-to-create-an-a-i-agent-to-analyze-matomo-analytics-using-n8n-for-free/)

## Get PDF or image
You need to create a new folder inside Google Drive for uploading your PDF and images.

Once you create a folder, you need to add your Google cloud user by going to Share -> Add user. The user email should be like: [email removed]

## Send to Openrouter
You need to set up an Openrouter account to use this. It sends the data to openrouter to extract text.

Use Header Auth. Name is "Authorization" and value is "Bearer {API token}".

## Vertex AI for image recogniztion
We send the photo to Vertex AI to extract text. You'll need to activate Vertex AI and add the correct rights to your Google cloud credentials. 
- Enable Vertex API
- Add vertex to user account
